segments.sn19.13:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ nicchaviṃ itthiṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ.
segments.sn19.13:1.2: Tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
segments.sn19.13:1.3: Sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti … pe … esā, bhikkhave, itthī imasmiṃyeva rājagahe aticārinī ahosi … pe ….
